snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV gameplay trailer and dev interview - PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct
snippet.description:
Get your first proper look at the combat and factions in the fourth entry in the epic Dawn of War series. We sat down with Jan Theysen and Elliott Verbiest to chat inspiration, influences, and some of exciting new upcoming features in the game.
